besluite.fout: 'Baie van hierdie druppeltjies saam vorm' hangs 'saam' after the subject and reads stiffly; 'vorm saam' is the natural order.
besluite.rede: Same meaning (the droplets together form a cloud), more natural word order, no protected word touched and no words added.
The comma marks snow as a separate addition; without it 'meestal' and 'waar dit koud genoeg is' can be read across both rain and snow, so the meaning moves.

besluite.fout: 'Nog water' can read as 'yet more water' rather than another part of the same rain.
besluite.rede: 'Ander water' states the partition of the rain clearly, matches 'Baie ander water' in the next block, and adds no words.

besluite.fout: 'herhaal' is used intransitively without an object or 'hom', which is not standard Afrikaans.
besluite.rede: 'gebeur oor en oor' keeps the meaning, fixes the grammar, leaves the protected word 'siklus' intact and keeps the word count the same.
